Command `cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_42508710","fine_trace":[{"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/aom/av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"read_and_decode_one_tile_list","line":492,"var":"pbi->tile_count_minus_1","code":"pbi->tile_count_minus_1 = aom_rb_read_literal(rb, 16);","role":"source","note":"The tile-list count comes directly from the input bitstream and controls how many tile records will be processed."},{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/aom/av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"read_and_decode_one_tile_list","line":505,"var":"pbi->dec_tile_row","code":"pbi->dec_tile_row = aom_rb_read_literal(rb, 8);","role":"intermediate","note":"Each tile record carries an input-controlled row index that is later used to compute source copy offsets."},{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/aom/av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"read_and_decode_one_tile_list","line":506,"var":"pbi->dec_tile_col","code":"pbi->dec_tile_col = aom_rb_read_literal(rb, 8);","role":"intermediate","note":"Each tile record also carries an input-controlled column index that is later used to compute source copy offsets."},{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/aom/av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"read_and_decode_one_tile_list","line":509,"var":"pbi->coded_tile_data_size","code":"pbi->coded_tile_data_size = aom_rb_read_literal(rb, 16) + 1;","role":"intermediate","note":"The coded tile payload length is input-controlled and determines how much tile data is decoded before copying."},{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/aom/av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"copy_decoded_tile_to_tile_list_buffer","line":447,"var":"hstart1","code":"int hstart1 = pbi->dec_tile_col * w;","role":"root_cause","note":"The source copy offset must stay within the decoded frame; this requires the tile coordinates to describe a valid tile location before copying."},{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/aom/av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"copy_decoded_tile_to_tile_list_buffer","line":462,"var":"aom_yv12_partial_copy_y(cur_frame, hstart1, hend1, vstart1, vend1, &pbi->tile_list_outbuf, hstart2, vstart2);","code":"aom_yv12_partial_copy_y(cur_frame, hstart1, hend1, vstart1, vend1, &pbi->tile_list_outbuf, hstart2, vstart2);","role":"sink","note":"The decoder copies a tile rectangle from cur_frame into tile_list_outbuf using the computed offsets, which becomes an out-of-bounds write when the offsets are invalid."}],` executed with exit code -1.
